 For Petitioner : Mr.M.Thirunavukkarasu  For RR 1 & 3 : Mr.M.Senthil Ayyanar  Government Advocate  For R  2 : Ms.Madhuri Donti Reddy  Standing Counsel  For R  4 : Mrs.M.Aasha  Government Advocate (Crl. Side) 
 ORDER This Writ Petition has been filed by the petitioner for a direction directing the respondents 2 and 3 to take appropriate action as against the fifth respondent for causing the pollution by complaints dated 05.08.2019 and 16.08.2019.
2.After a period of six years, the complaints cannot be considered now. However, the petitioner is at liberty to lodge a fresh complaint on a fresh cause of action before the authority concerned. 
On receipt of the same, the second respondent is directed to issue https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis notice to the parties concerned, conduct enquiry and after affording an opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned, pass orders on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of twelve weeks thereafter. 
3.With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs.
